Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami reviewed the proposed master plan for the comprehensive development of the Shri Madan Mohan Malaviya Oriental Research Institute, Rishikul, Haridwar , at the Chief Minister’s residence. A presentation on the proposed structure of the institute and its planned activities was made during the meeting. CM Pushkar Singh Dhami said Rishikul should be developed as a major centre for Ayurveda , Yoga and the Indian knowledge tradition . He directed that special priority be given to areas including Ayurveda, medical tourism, Yoga, astrology and Vedic mathematics as part of the institute’s development. The Chief Minister said AYUSH, Yoga and Sanskrit are among the identities associated with Uttarakhand and called for these elements to be reflected in the development of the Rishikul campus. He also emphasised the need for high-quality educational activities and an environment conducive to study and research in Indian knowledge systems, oriental sciences, Ayurveda and Yoga. Regarding the campus design, CM Pushkar Singh Dhami directed officials to follow oriental and traditional architectural styles . He said the exterior appearance and facades of the buildings should incorporate elements reflecting traditional architectural heritage, while the facilities and arrangements within the campus should be modern. The proposed development is intended to combine traditional architectural elements with contemporary infrastructure. The Chief Minister said this balance should form part of the campus’s overall identity. The development plan also takes into account Haridwar’s religious and spiritual significance and its location along the Ganga. The city attracts devotees and tourists from across India and abroad. CM Pushkar Singh Dhami said the development of Rishikul should reflect this context and provide visitors opportunities to learn about and experience Indian knowledge traditions, Ayurveda, Yoga and spirituality. The Chief Minister directed officials to implement the project in a time-bound manner , with clear phases and timelines for different works. He instructed that the development should be completed in phases within two years and that regular reviews of the progress should be conducted. From magical adventures to heartwarming coming-of-age stories, these animated films, including Howl’s Moving Castle, Ponyo and My Neighbor Totoro, are perfect for fans of cozy fantasy. Find out where to watch them in India. Studio Ghibli’s Kiki's Delivery Service is one of the most loved anime movies to date. The story follows a 13 year old witch named Kiki who leaves home with her talking cat and then starts living for a year alone in a new town. What makes the film so popular is how comforting it is, and its slice-of-life storytelling is one of a kind. If you also love Kiki's Delivery Service, here are some other films you can stream. Movies like Kiki's Delivery Service ​Song of the Sea ​Song of the Sea follows the story of a boy and his sister who go on a journey filled with Irish folklore and magical bits. It is packed with emotional storytelling and magical atmosphere. It is an excellent pick for Ghibli fans. It is best known for folklore, wonder, and heartfelt adventures. ​Where to watch: Netflix Ponyo ​Animated by Studio Ghibli and starring Yuria Nara, Hiroki Doi, Tomoko Yamaguchi, Kazushige Nagashima, Yūki Amami, and others, Ponyo is a Japanese animated fantasy movie. It tells the story of Ponyo, a goldfish-like creature who goes out of the ocean, and a 5-year-old boy helps her after she is washed ashore while being trapped in a glass jar. The movie was a massive success and grossed over $204 million worldwide. ​Where to watch: Netflix​ The Secret World of Arrietty​ Best known for gentle adventure and charming animation, the movie is about a little girl who secretly lives beneath the floorboards of a house. She meets a boy suddenly and her life then changes. Directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi, the movie stars Mirai Shida, Ryunosuke Kamiki, Shinobu Otake, Keiko Takeshita, Tatsuya Fujiwara, Tomokazu Miura, and Kirin Kiki. ​Where to watch: Netflix ​My Neighbor Totoro ​Directed by Hayao Miyazaki and starring Noriko Hidaka, Chika Sakamoto, and Hitoshi Takagi, the movie is about two young sisters who, after moving in with their father, experience bonds with wood spirits in postwar Japan. ​Where to watch: Netflix Howl’s Moving Castle ​Howl’s Moving Castle is a japanese animated fantasy film which has been written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki. The movie is about how, in the early 20th century, both magic and technology are present. It tells the story of Sophie, a young milliner who was turned into an elderly woman by a witch. Uttarakhand has initiated 63 parking projects with a combined capacity of 4,202 vehicles as part of efforts to improve facilities for tourists and pilgrims visiting the state. The projects are being taken up in different districts, with the government focusing on areas that receive significant tourist and religious footfall. CM Pushkar Singh Dhami has emphasized the development of tourist facilities as part of the state’s efforts to strengthen infrastructure and improve the experience of visitors. The parking projects are intended to address congestion and parking-related difficulties in important tourist destinations, religious centres and urban areas. The projects cover several hill districts. Almora has the highest planned capacity at 1,087 vehicles , followed by Nainital with 679, Champawat with 600 and Uttarkashi with 477. Pithoragarh has a planned capacity of 309 vehicles, while Rudraprayag has 304 and Pauri has 256. The projects in Chamoli, Tehri and Bageshwar have capacities of 201, 163 and 126 vehicles respectively. The state government is developing different types of parking facilities based on the requirements and availability of land at individual locations. These include surface parking, multilevel parking and roadside parking facilities . The approach is aimed at making better use of available space in areas where parking demand has increased. In Nainital , a parking project near the Metro Pole Hotel premises is being developed to address parking-related issues in the city. The information states that the facility will be developed in the area available near the premises. A parking facility is also being developed in Kainchi Dham , where the increasing number of devotees has created a need for additional parking infrastructure. The proposed facility is planned to accommodate more than 500 vehicles at a time, according to the information provided.
